import csv
from collections import Counter
from datetime import date
cards = list(csv.DictReader(open("flashcards.csv")))
print("cards:", len(cards), "ids unique:", len({c["id"] for c in cards}) == len(cards))
backs = {c["id"]: c["back"] for c in cards}
quiz = {"es-12": "si tuviera tiempo, viajaría", "es-04": "espero que vengas", "es-02": "Llevo dos años viviendo aquí", "es-11": "vale la pena", "es-07": "ayer fui al mercado", "st-04": "rejecting a true null hypothesis (false positive)", "st-06": "the method captures the true value in 95% of repeated samples", "st-03": "skewed data or outliers"}
print("quiz answers that differ from the card:", [k for k, v in quiz.items() if backs[k] != v])
plan = Counter({"2026-11-02": 13, "2026-11-03": 3, "2026-11-04": 1, "2026-11-09": 1})
print("max per day:", max(plan.values()), "sundays:", [d for d in plan if date.fromisoformat(d).weekday() == 6])
